meta.review_notes: Policy silent on contacts/phonebook and location/GPS access, which is typical for a photo editing app. AI training opt-out is available but has no retroactive effect.

app.name: Photoroom: AI Photo Editor
app.description: AI-powered photo editing tool for creating and editing images, including background removal, batch processing, and e-commerce integration.

verdict.one_liner: AI photo editor that uses your uploaded images to train its models, but offers an opt-out and does not sell your data.
verdict.summary: Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editor that accesses your camera and photos with permission. While it explicitly states it does not sell personal data and uses third-party payment processors to avoid handling credit cards directly, it uses uploaded images for AI model training with only a forward-looking opt-out. Data is shared with service providers including Apple and RevenueCat for refund checks, and browsing data is tracked via cookies. Some personal data is retained for extended periods even after account deletion requests.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Photoroom uses your uploaded photos for AI training with no retroactive opt-out, and retains some data for years after deletion. Consider whether you are comfortable with your images being used to train commercial AI models before uploading sensitive photos.

red.title: Your photos are used to train AI models
red.plain_english: By default, Photoroom uses the images you upload to improve and train its AI products and models. You can opt out, but this only stops future use and does not undo any training that already happened.

red.title: Browsing data shared for refund checks
red.plain_english: Photoroom sends your browsing and interaction data to Apple and RevenueCat to check if you qualify for refunds.

red.title: Data kept for years after you stop using the app
red.plain_english: Even if you delete your account, Photoroom may keep some data for a long time. Your account info can be kept up to 2 years after your last login and then archived for 5 more years. Purchase records are kept for 10 years.

red.title: Personal data may leave the European Union
red.plain_english: Photoroom is based in France, but your data may be sent to countries outside Europe because some of their service providers are located there.

green.title: You can opt out of AI training
green.plain_english: Photoroom lets you opt out of having your uploaded images used for AI model training by changing a setting in your account.

green.title: Photoroom never sees your credit card
green.plain_english: When you make a purchase, your credit card details are handled only by the payment service provider. Photoroom does not store or process your card information.

green.title: Explicitly says it does not sell your data
green.plain_english: Photoroom clearly states in its privacy policy that it does not sell or share personal data for advertising purposes as defined by California privacy law.

green.title: Strong European privacy rights available
green.plain_english: Because Photoroom is based in France, you have rights under European privacy law including the right to access, correct, delete, and move your data. They must respond within one month.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Photoroom accesses your phone's camera and photos, but only with your permission and only while you're using the app.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states that data sent by your phone's camera and photos stored on your phone are collected. Access is only made with your permission. Data is kept for the duration of use or until withdrawal of permission.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data sent by your phone's camera and photos stored on your phone. Access to the photos is only made with your permission.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Photoroom collects your location.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not explicitly address location or GPS data collection.
concerns: Policy silent on location and GPS access

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether Photoroom accesses your contacts.
categories.detail: No mention of contacts or phonebook access in the privacy policy.
concerns: Policy silent on contacts and phonebook access

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Photoroom needs access to photos stored on your phone so you can edit them. This access only happens with your permission.
categories.detail: Photos stored on the phone are accessed with user permission for editing services. Data kept for duration of use or until permission is withdrawn.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data sent by your phone's camera and photos stored on your phone. Access to the photos is only made with your permission.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Photoroom shares some of your data with service providers like Apple and RevenueCat for refund checks, and with Dub for referral programs if you opt in. They say they do not sell your personal data.
categories.detail: Data shared with sub-processors for hosting, notifications, user tracking, and security. Browsing and interaction data shared with Apple and RevenueCat for refund eligibility. Email addresses shared with Dub for referral programs with consent. Explicit statement that Photoroom does not 'sell' or 'share' personal data under CCPA.
categories.policy_excerpt: Your Personal data may be transmitted to third-party processors involved in the provision of the Services... we transmit your browsing and interaction data on the Photoroom Application to Apple and RevenueCat... we use Dub as a service provider to operate and manage referral programs.
concerns: Browsing data shared with Apple and RevenueCat
User tracking mentioned as third-party processor service

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Photoroom collects your email, name, and user ID when you create an account. You can sign in with Google, Facebook, or Apple.
categories.detail: Account data includes email address (via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth, or AppleAuth), full name, user ID, and optional profile photo. Retained until account deletion or up to 2 years from last connection, then archived for 5 years.
categories.policy_excerpt: Email address via GoogleAuth, FacebookAuth or AppleAuth (optional), Full name, User ID.
concerns: Account data retained for extended periods after last use

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Photoroom uses cookies for social network and audience measurement, which track your IP address and pages you view. You must give consent for these.
categories.detail: Social network and audience measurement cookies collect IP address and pages viewed with consent, retained up to 25 months. User tracking mentioned as a third-party processor service. Photoroom explicitly states they do not 'sell' or 'share' personal data for cross-context behavioral advertising under CCPA.
categories.policy_excerpt: Social network and audience measurement Cookies. Personal data collected (IP address, pages viewed, etc.) by the deposit of these Cookies. Consent. Up to 25 months.
concerns: Audience measurement cookies track IP and pages viewed
User tracking performed by third-party processors

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Photoroom says their app is not for kids under 13, but there is no strong system to check ages.
categories.detail: Applications not intended for children under 13. No knowingly collection from under 13. Users under 18 must have parental permission. No enforcement mechanism described.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our Applications and Services are not intended for and should not be used by children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. Users under 18 must have permission from their parent or guardian to use our Services.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Photoroom collects information about how you use the app, including your browsing and navigation data, to keep the app running smoothly.
categories.detail: Navigation information collected for proper functioning and security. Browsing and interaction data on the Photoroom Application collected. Retained for duration of navigation or until deletion request.
categories.policy_excerpt: Navigation information. Legitimate interest in providing a functional Services. For the duration of the navigation.
concerns: Data shared with Apple and RevenueCat for refund checks

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Photoroom collects information about the device you use, like your phone type, to make sure the app works properly.
categories.detail: Data relating to devices and equipment used collected for proper operation of the Application. Retained for duration of use or 30 days after deletion request. Not explicitly linked to advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: Data relating to devices and equipment used. Legitimate interest in providing a functional Application/ improving our Application.
concerns: Device data collected for service operation

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Photoroom does not collect any health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No mention of health or biometric data collection in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: When you buy something, Photoroom uses outside payment services and never sees your credit card number.
categories.detail: Transaction data transmitted by Store or Payment Services Provider. Photoroom does not process or keep credit card data. Purchase history, amount, and name retained for 10 years for accounting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Transaction data transmitted by the Store or by the Payment Services Provider... credit card or other payment methods data are not processed and kept by Photoroom but only by the Payment Services Provider.
concerns: Purchase data retained for 10 years for accounting

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can ask Photoroom to delete your data, but some information is kept for years for legal and accounting reasons even after you delete your account.
categories.detail: GDPR rights available including access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection. Account data deleted by user or kept up to 2 years from last connection, then archived 5 years. Accounting data kept 10 years. Response within one calendar month (up to three for complex requests).
categories.policy_excerpt: You can request the deletion of your personal data... Duration of use of the services (=Until the account is deleted by you or up to a period of 2 years from your last connection to your account), and then archived for 5 years.
concerns: Account data retained up to 2 years after last use and archived 5 years

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Photoroom says they will let you know if they change the privacy policy, but they don't explain how or give you advance notice.
categories.detail: Privacy policy may be amended and updated. The company states they will 'set up a way to inform you of this change' but does not specify the method, timing, or requirement for active re-consent.
categories.policy_excerpt: The Privacy Policy may be amended and updated... we will set up a way to inform you of this change.
concerns: Vague notification method with no specifics on advance notice or re-consent
